 Al Nassr vs Al Kholood Tonight: Will Cristiano Ronaldo Play? Check the Schedule, Score Prediction, and Team Strengths
 Check the schedule, score prediction, and team strengths for the Al Nassr vs Al Kholood match in the Saudi Pro League. Will Cristiano Ronaldo play?
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Keisya Anjani 
 October 29, 2026, 15:49 WITA · 6 min read 
 Image caption: Illustration of the Al Nassr vs Al Kholood duel in the 2026/2027 Saudi Pro League. This match is in the spotlight due to the potential appearance of Cristiano Ronaldo for Al Nassr. (Illustration/Aktualita.co) 
 RIYADH, Aktualita.co -  The Al Nassr vs Al Kholood match is one of the interesting fixtures in the continuation of the 2026/2027 Saudi League. The 12th-week duel of the Saudi Pro League is scheduled to take place at Al-Awwal Park Stadium, Riyadh, on Thursday (10/29/2026) evening local time or Friday (10/30/2026) early morning WIB. 
 Football fans' attention is once again focused on Cristiano Ronaldo. The Portuguese striker is expected to start from the first minute to help Al Nassr maintain their positive trend while chasing Al Hilal at the top of the standings. 
 Advertisement 
 Al Nassr enters the match with much more convincing momentum compared to the visitors. Ange Postecoglou's squad occupies second place in the standings with 25 points from 10 matches, while Al Kholood is in ninth place with 12 points. 
 Despite being superior in player quality and performance, Al Nassr still needs to be wary of potential surprises from the visitors. The tight competition at the top means that dropping points in matches like this could affect their chances in the title race. 
 Al Nassr vs Al Kholood Schedule and Kick-off Time 
 Based on the official Saudi Pro League schedule, the match between Al Nassr and Al Kholood will take place on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 21:00 Saudi Arabia time. 
 For football fans in Indonesia, the match will take place early Friday morning with the following details: 
 Match: Al Nassr vs Al Kholood 
 Competition: Saudi Pro League 2026/2027, 12th week 
 Date: Friday, October 30, 2026 (Indonesian time) 
 Kick-off: 01:00 WIB / 02:00 WITA / 03:00 WIT 
 Stadium: Al-Awwal Park, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia 
 Playing in front of their own supporters is a distinct advantage for Al Nassr. The team nicknamed The Knights of Najd has a great opportunity to take the initiative to attack from the beginning of the match. 
 Will Cristiano Ronaldo Play? 
 Questions regarding the possibility of Cristiano Ronaldo playing are a focus ahead of the Al Nassr vs Al Kholood match. 
 As of Thursday (10/29/2026), Ronaldo is expected to be in the starting lineup. There has been no official confirmation regarding his absence from the match. 
 The player wearing the number seven jersey also appeared in Al Nassr's 3-1 victory over Al Faisaly on October 23. This condition is an indication that Ronaldo is still an important part of Postecoglou's game plan. 
 Ronaldo is likely to return as the spearhead of the attack, with support from players such as Sadio Mane, Joao Felix, and Abdullah Al-Hamdan . 
 This combination provides several options for Al Nassr to break down the opponent's defense, both through attacks from the flanks and direct passes into the penalty box. 
 However, the decision regarding whether Ronaldo will start or play from the bench can only be confirmed after the official lineup is announced before kick-off. 
 Al Nassr's Strength: Productive and Hard to Beat 
 Al Nassr has shown quite consistent performance throughout the start of the 2026/2027 Saudi League season. 
 From the 10 matches played, they have recorded eight wins, one draw, and one loss. 
 Attacking productivity is one of their main strengths. Al Nassr has scored 23 goals and only conceded eight, showing a balance between sharpness in the front line and defensive organization. 
 In the last four matches in all competitions, Al Nassr has also managed to win consecutively. 
 These positive results include a 3-0 win over Al Diriyah, 3-1 against Neftchi Fargona, 1-0 over NEOM, and 3-1 when facing Al Faisaly. 
 Ronaldo's presence provides a threat in the finishing area. Meanwhile, Sadio Mane's movement and Joao Felix's creativity can open up space for other players. 
 However, the condition of several defenders remains a concern. Sultan Al Ghannam is still recovering from a knee ligament injury, while the readiness of Mohamed Simakan and Kingsley Coman was in the spotlight ahead of the match. 
 Postecoglou needs to ensure a balanced game so that the desire to score early goals does not open up counter-attack opportunities for the opponent. 
 Al Kholood Comes with Defensive Problems 
 A different situation is being experienced by Al Kholood, who is trying to stop a negative trend. 
 Des Buckingham's team has collected 12 points from 10 matches, with a record of three wins, three draws, and four losses. 
 Their biggest problem lies in defense. Al Kholood has already conceded 21 goals, including 13 goals in the last four league matches. 
 During that period, Al Kholood lost 0-2 to Al Riyadh, was beaten 0-5 by Al Qadsiah, surrendered 2-3 to Al Faisaly, and lost again 0-3 when facing Al Ettifaq. 
 This series of results shows their vulnerability when facing pressure, especially when the opponent manages to control the game in the defensive area. 
 However, Al Kholood still has a chance to put up a fight through counter-attacks. 
 Julien Domingues is one of the players to watch. The striker has recorded four league goals this season and has the potential to be a threat if he gets space behind the Al Nassr defense. 
 Buckingham is expected to rely on more disciplined game organization to limit the hosts' opportunities. 
 Head to Head Al Nassr vs Al Kholood 
 The history of meetings between the two teams further strengthens Al Nassr's position as the favorite. 
 From the last four meetings in the Saudi Pro League, Al Nassr has recorded three wins and one draw. Al Kholood has never beaten them. 
 The last meeting took place on January 30, 2026. At that time, Al Nassr won 3-0 at Al Kholood's home through goals from Cristiano Ronaldo, Mohamed Simakan, and Kingsley Coman. 
 Previously, Al Nassr also won 2-0 in September 2025 and 3-1 in March 2025. 
 The only draw occurred in October 2024 when the two teams played to a 3-3 score. 
 Overall, Al Nassr scored 11 goals in those four meetings, while Al Kholood produced four goals. 
 This record shows Al Nassr's historical advantage, although previous match results do not automatically determine the outcome of this meeting. 
 Al Nassr vs Al Kholood Score Prediction 
 Looking at recent performance, Al Nassr has a better chance of taking three points. 
 The superiority in player quality, attacking productivity, meeting record, and home factor make Ronaldo and his teammates more favored. 
 Conversely, Al Kholood must find a way to overcome the defensive weaknesses seen in the last few matches. 
 If Al Nassr manages to score first, the match could become increasingly difficult for the visitors because they have to abandon their defensive approach to chase the deficit. 
 Al Kholood can still provide a surprise if they can maintain discipline and take advantage of the hosts' mistakes. However, with the current condition of both teams, that chance is relatively smaller. 
 Score prediction Aktualita.co: Al Nassr 3-0 Al Kholood. 
 This match is also an opportunity for Cristiano Ronaldo to show his influence again in the top competition of the Saudi League. His presence will further strengthen Al Nassr's chances of maintaining their winning momentum.
